armadillo_droideka.name: Armadillo Droideka
armadillo_droideka.description: Foldable machine-creature enemy with rigid scutes, split equator rings, deployable legs, and fire-bolt burst attacks.

armadillo_eggling.name: Armadillo Eggling
armadillo_eggling.description: Small aggressive roll-form variant focused on contact pressure, tuned for swarm behavior.

origami_droideka.name: Origami Droideka
origami_droideka.description: Magic-ball inspired fold shell using accordion pleats and braided ring bands; rolls compressed and deploys to fire.

waterbomb_enemy.name: Waterbomb Enemy
waterbomb_enemy.description: True rigid-foldable origami enemy using waterbomb tessellation. Faces remain rigid during folding; geometry is computed from kinematic constraints. Rolls collapsed, unfolds to flower shape when attacking.

miura_crawler.name: Miura Crawler
miura_crawler.description: Miura-ori folding enemy - flat corrugated sheet that crawls like an inchworm. Lies flat and nearly invisible, pops up when player approaches, uses zigzag locomotion. Can squeeze through gaps when flattened.

kresling_spire.name: Kresling Spire
kresling_spire.description: Kresling origami sniper tower - twisting cylinder that extends from compact disc to tall tower. Rolls as disc to reposition, rises by untwisting to snipe from elevation, collapses rapidly to relocate.

scissor_stalker.name: Scissor Stalker
scissor_stalker.description: Spider-like enemy with Hoberman scissor linkage legs. Legs extend 3x their compact length for dramatic reach. Stalks with partially extended legs, pounces by rapidly extending, slams down to attack.

kaleidocycle_enemy.name: Kaleidocycle
kaleidocycle_enemy.description: Tumbling ring of tetrahedra with 4 attack modes. Rolls toward player while continuously rotating through itself. Each face color triggers different attack: Fire (red), Ice (blue), Spike (purple), Shield (gold).

proximity_spawner.name: Proximity Spawner
proximity_spawner.description: Spawns enemies when player enters radius. Respawns after enemy death. Configure with type, spawn_radius, despawn_radius, respawn_delay.

sphere_droideka.name: Sphere Droideka
sphere_droideka.description: Armadillidiidae-style spherical droideka. Rolls as compact ball of overlapping shell plates, unfolds to tripod stance with shield dome and twin blasters. Star Wars droideka inspired.
